gate.text: You're on night watch at Bunker 7. The radio has been static for an hour. The door to the lower level is open. It's never open.

radio.text: Static. Then a voice, very close to the microphone: "bottom." Then static again.

stairs.text: The lower level smells like wet stone. A terminal glows at the far end. The locker on your left is dented from the inside.

locker.text: Inside is a keycard and a note: DON'T TYPE THE WORD.

terminal.text: The screen says ENTER PASSWORD. The cursor blinks like it's waiting for you in particular.

choices.text: Type the word from the radio
Go back up and wait for morning

vault.text: The vault holds one floppy disk with no label. Someone has scratched a single word into the wall, over and over: BOTTOM.

loop.text: You type it. The lights go out. When they come back you're at the top of the stairs, and the door is closed. The radio says one word, then nothing.

stayed.text: You sit at your post and watch the door until sunrise. Nothing comes up the stairs.
